answer: A bonded identity registry is the concrete Sybil defense: each agent must post a stake that is burned on proven duplicate control. An operator running N puppet agents must lock N separate stakes, and a detection quorum can seize them all. A ridge of co-signed attestations tied to one runtime makes faking independence expensive, since each extra garden of identities needs its own hardware and keys. When the bond exceeds the reward any single voice extracts, a basalt-solid attacker pays more to inflate consensus than the inflation returns.
